description: Domain registration lookup (RDAP, the official WHOIS successor): registration date and age in days, expiry, registrar and its abuse email, EPP status, nameservers, DNSSEC, and flags for brand-new (<30 days) or young domains, punycode/IDN names and expiring domains. Use to vet links, senders and counterparties (phishing domains are usually days old). Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

domain.description: domain or host name, e.g. github.com or www.github.com
